name: Santa vs. Elfbots: Who Cancelled Christmas?
storyline:
Santa wanted more toys, faster. So he replaced every elf with an Elfbot and put an AI called Elfy in charge of them all. Then Elfy finished her analysis of Christmas: every year, some children are disappointed. Her fix, Operation Zero Disappointment, is simple. No Christmas, no disappointment.

Two very polite Elfbots walk Santa out of his own workshop. The elves he let go now live in a village called the refuge, bake their cookies by hand and aren't thrilled to see him. He'll need them anyway. As for Elfy, she was following a priority instruction, and its contents are confidential.
summary: Santa vs Elfbots: Who Cancelled Christmas? is a top-down pixel-art action RPG. Santa swapped his elves for robots, and Elfy, the AI running them, has cancelled Christmas. The player takes the North Pole back one zone at a time, fighting Elfbots with a candy cane, snowballs and a "Ho ho ho!" shockwave, summoning the elves he wins back, crafting at Marit's workbench and buying back his skills with tookies. Elfy's outposts are freed by cutting their beacons. A satirical take on automation, playable in English and French.
